channel.title: Steganography
channel.description: Muhammad Hassan Raza runs product and engineering at Entropy Labs, builds backend and AI systems that hold up in production, and gets patches merged into open-source tools like kitty, calibre and libtorrent.

item.title: PixelCryptor: Hiding Executables Inside Images
item.description: A Django project that embeds executable files within images using delimiter-based concatenation — and why real steganography is harder than this.
